//: Guardrails record — docs/guardrails.md says what each capability means here. Every capability appears once: either the tool implementing it, or off with why and who. Changes require human review via CODEOWNERS.

format.enforced_at: pre-commit (staged files via lint-staged), pre-push via verify, CI

lint.tool: eslint (TS/JS) + SDK analysers via TreatWarningsAsErrors/AnalysisLevel=latest (C#) + bicep build (Bicep) + markdownlint-cli2 (MD)

coverage.tool: c8 --lines=80 (app) + coverlet XPlat Code Coverage with scripts/check-dotnet-coverage.mjs floor at 80% (api)

secrets.tool: secretlint (preset-recommend + pattern rule blocking home-dir/UNC paths)
secrets.enforced_at: pre-commit (staged), pre-push via verify, CI; host push protection per BOOTSTRAP-REPORT

ci-verify.tool: GitHub Actions: .github/workflows/guardrails.yml runs npm run verify on every PR

supply-chain.tool: Dependabot (npm + nuget + github-actions) + npm min-release-age=7 in .npmrc + CodeQL default setup
